china-1913:p0108_1.rationale: Lists the years in which Western nations first had direct trade dealings with China. The content is dates and nation names, so it is textual. It is a small historical list of commercial contacts. No detailed tag fits.
review_questions: Consider a tag for the history of foreign trade contacts.

china-1913:p0117_1.rationale: Counts foreign indoor staff of the Maritime Customs Revenue Department by grade. This is civil-service personnel.

china-1913:p0117_2.rationale: Counts Chinese indoor staff of the Customs Revenue Department by grade. This is civil-service personnel.

china-1913:p0117_3.rationale: Counts foreign outdoor staff of the Customs Revenue Department by grade. This is civil-service personnel.

china-1913:p0117_4.rationale: Counts Chinese outdoor staff of the Customs Revenue Department. This is civil-service personnel.

china-1913:p0117_5.rationale: Counts foreign coast staff (commanders, officers, engineers) of the Customs revenue cruisers. This is customs service personnel.

china-1913:p0117_6.rationale: Gives the number of Chinese steamer and launch hands in the Customs coast staff. This is customs service personnel.

china-1913:p0118_1.rationale: Counts foreign and Chinese staff of the Maritime Customs Marine Department (engineers, harbour staff, lights staff). This is administrative personnel.

china-1913:p0119_1.rationale: Native customs revenue in Haikuan taels by port, 1908-1911. This is revenue collected by customs authorities.

china-1913:p0119_2.rationale: Lists customs ports with province, opening date, the treaty basis and the estimated Chinese population. It is organised around the treaty-port system. It is mixed text and statistics.
